package probe

import (
	"context"
	"os/exec"
)

func toolchain(ctx context.Context) error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", "out", "./cmd/x")
	if out, err := build.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	list := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "go", "list", "-deps", "./cmd/x")
	_, err := list.Output()
	return err
}
